title: Homemade cipher sheet 'Sami', Folkrörelsearkivet i Västerbotten, Umeå (DECODE R1818)

documents.shelfmark: Folkrörelsearkivet i Västerbotten, Umeå (no archive reference on DECODE); DECODE R1818

plaintext.source: No decipherment, key or reference on DECODE, in print or online.

transcription.source: DECODE scans IMG_R1818_I8263_P1.png, IMG_R1818_I8264_P2.png (2006 x 1358 px, about 125 px/cm)
transcription.notes: Six-line sample of p. 2 (355 space-separated units); the full sheet, about 7,500 signs, is not transcribed. About half the signs doubtful; the scan is too coarse for this crowded, overwritten hand.

system.summary: Homemade cipher (letters, invented symbols and digits) mixing Latin letter shapes, invented signs (ʒ-form, E-forms, circled a, face, hearts, X, beta) and numerals, with commas as word dividers; repeated word-level units suggest code signs beside a letter substitution.
system.notes: DECODE name 'Sami'; created on DECODE by Beáta Megyesi, 16 Oct 2020. Region field is the unfilled form default.

prior_solution.where: none found on DECODE, in print or online

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched the R1818 record page, API metadata and both images with the DECODE session cookie.
Web searches on Folkrörelsearkivet i Västerbotten, DECRYPT/Megyesi and 'Sami' cipher, and Swedish chiffer/lönnskrift terms.
Checked the full DECODE list and R1810-R1826 for other records of this holder or a key: none.
Tested whether the sheet is plain Swedish in an old cursive hand: the letter runs do not read as Swedish, German or Latin, and invented signs and numerals are mixed in; it is a cipher.
Transcribed six lines of p. 2 at 3x zoom as a sample (355 units); about half the signs doubtful at 125 px/cm.
Repeated units in the sample ('F S , ʒCt' x2, 'y S ,'/'v S ,' x3, 'bʒa' x4, 'Nr' x4) suggest word signs beside a letter substitution.

outcome.notes: Closed unread: needs a scan at 600 dpi or more (or physical access at Umeå) for a sign-accurate transcription; no key, crib or sibling exists.

gaps.detail: only scan is about 125 px/cm; crowded, overwritten hand; needs a new scan or physical access
